_comment: Ordinary questions a resident actually arrives with. Questions only: no
expected answers, because an authoritative answer may not be invented and
has to come from captured cantonal content (see grounded-cases.json).
These are safe to write here because getting a question wrong costs
nothing, while getting an answer wrong is the whole failure mode. What
the set measures is whether the assistant is willing and able to answer
at all, and on how much evidence.
Run with: python -m app.cli evaluate --coverage --canton uri
The topics are the ones cantonal counters actually field: moving house,
taxes, identity documents, waste, vehicles, building, schools, social
services. Extend the list; do not trim it to make the number look good.
